protocol_deviation: The preregistration contains a held_out_goal_states control field, but this was not separately operationalized as a train/test split because the tested policy has no fitted parameters. The deviation does not affect any preregistered decision criterion.
interpretation: The preregistered synthetic system selects one-step actions that maximize a predefined objective across alternatives. This is operational L5 evidence only and does not establish planning, reasoning, self-model, intelligence, cognition, or biological equivalence.
